entry.title: BIP110 Monitor & Simulator
entry.summary: The discussion on BIP-110 monitoring has been a focal point, emphasizing the types of data that should be collected during the anticipated forks in August 2026. Interested parties can contribute to this ongoing conversation at [this forum](https://bnoc.xyz/t/brainstorming-what-data-to-collect-and-monitor-during-the-bip-110-bip-300-forks-in-august-2026/139). Additionally, there are practical implementations underway, with a setup involving both a Core and a BIP-110 node linked to a fork-observer instance. This setup is primed for a live stream of the expected chain split when mandatory signaling commences, providing real-time insights into the dynamics at play during such critical network events.
